guides.title: 架構、算例與證據：編譯器前端與中介表示
guides.titleEn: Architecture, examples and evidence: Compiler front ends and intermediate representations
guides.concept: 以詞法、語義與可驗證 IR連結 16 個技術單元，新增 32 步原理、架構、假想算例、實驗設計與失效驗證。
guides.conceptEn: Sixteen technical units connect lexing, semantics and verifiable ir through 32 new tasks covering principles, architecture, assumed calculations, experiment design and failure validation.
procedure: 先觀看師傅示意，辨識「詞法契約」的資料、控制與時間關係。字元序列被分成帶位置的 token。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「追蹤數字、識別字與運算子。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
先觀看師傅示意，辨識「錯誤恢復」的資料、控制與時間關係。診斷需定位錯誤而非無限循環。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「比較缺括號與非法 token。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
先觀看師傅示意，辨識「型別檢查」的資料、控制與時間關係。型別錯誤應在明定階段拒絕。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「列出可轉換與不可轉換例。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
先觀看師傅示意，辨識「CFG」的資料、控制與時間關係。控制流邊與文本先後不同。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「畫入口到出口的可達邊。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
先觀看師傅示意，辨識「支配關係」的資料、控制與時間關係。定義需在適用路徑支配使用。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「檢查分支內定義外部使用。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
先觀看師傅示意，辨識「回歸測試」的資料、控制與時間關係。正負用例需同時覆蓋語言契約。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「建立 token、AST 與結果對照。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
procedureEn: Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for lexer contract. Characters become location-bearing tokens. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Trace numbers, identifiers and operators. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.

Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for error recovery. Diagnostics locate errors without endless loops. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Compare missing brackets and illegal tokens. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.

Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for type checking. Type errors are rejected at defined stages. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: List permitted and forbidden conversions. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.

Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for cfg. Control-flow edges differ from textual order. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Draw reachable entry-to-exit edges. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.

Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for dominance. Definitions dominate uses on relevant paths. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Check uses of branch-local definitions. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.

Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for regression tests. Positive and negative cases cover language contracts. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Build token, AST and result comparisons. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.
evidence: 提交「Undefined 邊界」的輸入與結果對照、競爭原因、接受／保留理由；逐項說明「明列除零與溢位語義。」的證據與尚未驗證範圍。
提交「回歸測試」的兩情境架構／狀態圖、參數表與可反駁預測；標出哪些資料支援「正負用例需同時覆蓋語言契約。」。
提交「回歸測試」的輸入與結果對照、競爭原因、接受／保留理由；逐項說明「建立 token、AST 與結果對照。」的證據與尚未驗證範圍。
evidenceEn: Submit undefined-behavior boundaries input/output comparisons, competing causes and pass/hold rationale; state evidence and untested scope for the experiment.
Submit regression tests two-case architecture/state diagrams, parameter table and falsifiable prediction; identify evidence supporting the principle.
Submit regression tests input/output comparisons, competing causes and pass/hold rationale; state evidence and untested scope for the experiment.
pitfalls: 常見誤判：Phi 的輸入與 CFG predecessor 無關。 本步需分開功能正確、資源上界與證據範圍，不可把假想結果當作真實平臺保證。
pitfallsEn: Common mistake: Phi inputs are independent of CFG predecessors. Separate correctness, resource bounds and evidence scope; hypothetical results are not real-platform guarantees.

guides.scope: 公開原理的雙語工程教育；工作臺是概念模擬，不是特定廠商產品的完整模擬器。數值為自行設定的教學假設。實驗僅限離線模型、自己的隔離環境或明確授權的測試資料；不掃描或改動真實第三方系統，未測平臺保留未決。
guides.scopeEn: Bilingual engineering education from public principles; the workbench is a conceptual simulation, not a complete simulator of any vendor product. Inputs are original teaching assumptions. Experiments use offline models, owned isolated environments or explicitly authorized test data, never scan/modify third-party systems and leave untested platforms unresolved.

related.title: 即時編譯與程式最佳化
related.why: IR、支配與語義驗證可直接沿用
related.whyEn: IR, dominance and semantic validation transfer
related.transfer: IR、支配與語義驗證可直接沿用
related.transferEn: IR, dominance and semantic validation transfer
related.difference: JIT 另需執行時金鑰、守衛與程式碼生命週期
related.differenceEn: JIT also needs runtime symbols, guards and code lifetimes
practice: 由「詞法契約」畫出兩課共用與需要重定義的資料、控制及時間邊界。
針對「JIT 另需執行時金鑰、守衛與程式碼生命週期」各指定一個能辨識差異的實驗；只使用虛構資料或明確授權隔離環境。
將本課算例移植到衍生課：逐項重查方程適用條件、單位、版本、故障假設，標示不能沿用的數字。
practiceEn: From lexer contract, map shared and redefined data, control and timing boundaries.
For "JIT also needs runtime symbols, guards and code lifetimes", specify a discriminating experiment for each course using fictional data or an explicitly authorized isolated environment.
Transfer the worked example: recheck equation scope, units, versions and fault assumptions; mark values that cannot carry over.
